mutations.name: only a burndown-slices block lists slices, so a bare tag still holds
kills: sh-cleanup task keep mode with a slices tag and no slices block closes after S4 lands when its plan's headings list S1-S4

mutations.name: a slice landed outside a derived list does not mark the list partial
kills: sh-cleanup task keep mode with a slices tag and no slices block holds on the tag when a slice landed outside the list, since the list is then partial

mutations.name: one undescribed item no longer voids a prose slice list
kills: listedSlices lists nothing from one undescribed item among described ones, so a first landing cannot close the task

mutations.name: a slice moved to another task holds the original open
kills: sh-cleanup task keep mode with a slices tag and no slices block closes when the last slice lands and the notes hand the remaining slice to another task

mutations.name: a slice PR registered --last-slice never closes its task
kills: sh-cleanup task keep mode with a slices tag and no slices block closes on a --last-slice slice PR though the headings list an unlanded slice

mutations.name: an unsliced PR never carries the last open slice
kills: sh-cleanup task keep mode with a plan's slices closes when the PR body names every unlanded slice, as #3257 did for slices a and b
sh-cleanup task keep mode with a plan's slices closes when a bridge PR carries the plan's only slice and its body names none, as #3250 did

mutations.name: a PR body naming some unlanded slices carries them all
kills: sh-cleanup task keep mode with a plan's slices keeps the task open when the PR body names only some of the unlanded slices
